visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top banner with decorative background, eyebrow and title; optional foreground photo
visualCharacteristics.background: Light grey band with the decorative swoosh as a CSS background
visualCharacteristics.typography: Optional eyebrow with accent dash, H1; subpage heroes may add a description paragraph and a down-arrow link CTA
visualCharacteristics.alignment: Left by default; centered when the section has style 'centered'
visualCharacteristics.layout: With a foreground photo: title left, photo right at 900px and up (the photo overflows the 534px grey band); photo above the title on mobile

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = background picture; row 2 = optional eyebrow paragraph, H1, optional description paragraph(s), optional paragraph containing only a link (CTA), optional foreground picture (same cell or a second cell)

sectionStyles.effect: Centers the eyebrow, title and description

options.name: subpage
options.effect: Banner sized to its content (subpages); without it the banner keeps the home page's 535px height

options.name: wide
options.effect: With subpage: the title area spans the full width instead of 550px

reuseGuidance: One hero for all pages. A foreground photo in the content cell switches to the split layout automatically (no separate block). Subpages add option 'subpage' ('wide' for full-width titles). Centered titles use section-metadata Style 'centered', not a new variant.
